assertions: The dog will be recovered — it is not permanently lost
The dog is still in London, within the city and not strayed far away, because its significator is in a sign of the same triplicity as the ascendant which signifies London
Search the western part of the city, in the southern quarter verging to the west — i.e. to the south-west / westward from the querent at Temple Bar

The dog is hidden and out of open sight, kept indoors or in an enclosed/obscure place in that quarter rather than wandering the streets, shown by the Moon in an airy sign under the beams of the Sun and Sun and Moon in the 8th
The dog is alive and will be restored to its home/owner, its significator applying to a trine of the cusp of the 6th house
Recovery, or certain news/return of the dog, comes on the following Monday, when the Sun applies by dexter aspect to Saturn, lord of the ascendant
summary: The dog will be recovered on the following Monday; it is still in London to the west/south-west, hidden indoors in someone's keeping.
method: Lilly horary astrology (Christian Astrology Book II, lost small beasts: 6th house and its lord for the dog, ascendant and Saturn for the querent, whole-sign/classical rules)
reasoning: Querent = ascendant and Saturn (Saturn on/near Asc). Dog = 6th sign and lord. Same triplicity as ascendant = still in London, not far. Western sign plus southern quarter verging west = search west inclining south (south-west). Moon airy, combust/under beams, Sun and Moon in 8th = dog concealed indoors, not visible roaming. Dog's significator applying by trine to 6th cusp = restoration to its place and recovery, dog alive. Sun applying dexter to Saturn, lord of Asc, perfecting on the following Monday = timing of return/news to the querent on Monday.
